description: The line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, SMoE and SimSMoE, over the course of training, as measured by Bits Per Character (BPC) on the y-axis against Training Steps (scaled by ×10³) on the x-axis. The x-axis spans from 0 to approximately 50 (×10³), with major tick marks at intervals of 10 (×10³), indicating a linear scale. The y-axis ranges from 1.2 to 2.2 BPC, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The black line with triangle markers represents “SMoE Validating,” which begins at approximately 2.2 BPC, drops sharply to around 1.45 BPC by 10×10³ steps, then gradually decreases to about 1.4 BPC by 20×10³ steps before stabilizing with minor fluctuations near 1.4 BPC through 50×10³ steps. The magenta line with diamond markers, labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” starts at the same 2.2 BPC, follows a nearly identical sharp decline to ~1.45 BPC by 10×10³ steps, and then continues to decrease slightly to ~1.38 BPC by 50×10³ steps, remaining consistently below the SMoE line after ~15×10³ steps. Both lines exhibit convergence toward a plateau, with SimSMoE achieving a marginally lower and more stable validation BPC in later training stages.
